title: Applied AI Architect
summary: Senior AI Engineer with 8+ years guiding ML and LLM systems from discovery and prototype to production across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps. Designs agentic and RAG applications in LangGraph with evaluation, tracing and observability built in, and has guided 15+ clients through technical POCs and consulting. Works with stakeholders to turn business problems into use cases, architectures and measurable results. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Enterprise Knowledge Assistant Architecture
bullets: Designed a reference architecture for enterprise knowledge assistants, combining RAG over internal documents with tool-calling agents and access controls, using GPT-4 through its API.
Evaluated answer quality with LLM evaluators and tracing against agreed business success criteria, and deployed the prototype with FastAPI and Docker alongside a documented path to production.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Applied AI Architect role on the Large Enterprise team. For the past few years my work has sat between a client's problem and a working AI system: finding the use case worth building, prototyping it, and staying with it until it runs in production. Getting from a promising demo to real adoption is the thread through my career.

OpenAI's models are now part of how large organizations plan their work, and helping those teams move from evaluation to durable value is where I want to put my experience. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to London together and settle there long term, building our life around this next step.

I would bring hands-on credibility to technical conversations. At Viavi I prototyped 15+ AI applications from client requirements, and 7 of them moved into production or paid client work. At United Health Group I took a lab-extraction agent into production, handling about 1,800 lab documents, with evaluation and tracing built in from the start.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It reminds me that AI only counts when real people adopt it and it helps them. I would be glad to talk about how I could support your enterprise customers.
